Only when she truly stepped into the spotlight did she realize that being swept along by forces beyond her control was simply the norm. "Go, child. Take the stage. For the Triple-Faced Soul, for The Family, and for everyone." The thunderous voice left no room for refusal. Rally after rally, she wove sweet dreams of Harmony for her audiences with a voice growing ever more weary. But looking upon the same zeal burning in the eyes of the crowd, she felt a sudden shiver run down her spine. "Robin, do you still hold true to the Family's Path of Harmony?" She had lost count of how many times an envoy of the main Family had come to interrogate members of the Oak Family like this. "I have always been faithful to the Path of Harmony." "Then answer this: Will you uphold the Family's philosophy, uniting all through song, that they may be united as one?" "I..." Her throat ran dry, and she found herself speechless. She often dreamed of being thrust onto a grand, exalted stage. Countless cold and indifferent messengers pulled at her limbs. She opened her mouth, yet a voice that was not her own came out; she raised her arm, yet it moved against her will. In her hands were endless stringed puppets beneath the stage. They followed her every step, spinning and leaping in kind. She wanted to struggle. She wanted to run. But when she jolted awake, she found herself exactly where she started. On those sleepless nights, she chose to stop tossing and turning. Instead, she stepped out into the deep Penaconian night. Wandering through the darkness, she sought to leave it all behind, pouring herself into the things she still had power to change. She returned to Dreamflux Reef, raising funds through charity performances to support struggling residents, and continued sponsoring the growth and education of the children there. She visited every part of the dreamscape. Her songs consoled the weary workers tucked away in its forgotten corners, as she offered them free music lessons. She listened to the prayers and wishes of every soul who came to confess, never making assertions, only sharing her own inspiration... "Whether it's the strong defending the weak or the strong exploiting the weak... what I've always cared about is each of those vulnerable individuals and their dignity..."
